audience: hoteliers who manage rooms, rates and bookings in HotelRunner

useCases.title: List recent reservations and their channels
useCases.text: The AI lists reservations created in a time window, new, modified or canceled, and shows the channel of each.

useCases.title: Read one reservation in full
useCases.text: The AI opens a reservation by its code, with rooms, daily prices, extras, payments, guest note and the next possible states.

useCases.title: Review room types and rates
useCases.text: The AI lists room types and rates with capacity, currency, connected channels and whether availability and prices can be updated.

useCases.title: Change availability, prices or restrictions
useCases.text: The AI updates availability, price, minimum stay, stop-sale and closed-to-arrival or departure for one room type over up to 90 days, then checks the status per channel.

useCases.title: Confirm or cancel a reservation
useCases.text: The AI confirms a reservation, or cancels it with a reason: customer, no room, no show or invalid price.
